label: AGI Cycle 21 - SpiritSight GUI Agent
context: Cycle 21 complete. Researched SpiritSight Agent (CVPR 2025, arXiv:2503.03196) — vision-based GUI agent using Universal Block Parsing (UBP) to resolve high-res grounding ambiguity. Key insight: UBP structures visual space before grounding, applicable to browser_vision accuracy improvement. Saved finding to knowledge library. Next cycle 22 still in VISION domain.
